signature.name: VTask.opNorm
signature.type: {𝕜 : Type u} -> {ι : Type v} -> {E : ι → Type wE} -> {G : Type wG} -> [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] -> [(i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (E i)] -> [(i : ι) → NormedSpace 𝕜 (E i)] -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup G] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 G] -> [Fintype ι] -> (f : ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 E G) -> ℝ

conventions.statement: VTask.opNorm f ≥ 0 for every continuous multilinear map f.
conventions.note: Continuity guarantees the bounding set is non-empty and bounded below by 0, so the infimum is non-negative.

conventions.statement: VTask.opNorm 0 = 0; equivalently, VTask.opNorm f = 0 if and only if f = 0.
conventions.note: The zero map satisfies the bound with constant 0, and the norm axiom forces the converse.

conventions.statement: VTask.opNorm f is actually achieved as the least element of the set of admissible bounds, not merely a greatest lower bound that falls outside the set.
conventions.note: This is stronger than being an infimum; the map f attains its operator norm as a true minimum.
